finding: The address editor starts with Province and has no Region selector. Province/City/Barangay cascading exists, but the exact Region-change workflow specified by this case is absent.

marker: Only draft or rejected products can be deleted.
finding: Active products cannot be deleted by the seller (only drafts/rejected products). The required Seller 2 deletion of the active wishlisted P-05 cannot be performed through the current product workflow.
The implementation defaults to auto-completion after 3 days, not 7 days; auto-complete is scheduled hourly. The workbook requires the order to remain uncompleted until the seven-day boundary.
Before selecting a variation, the product page renders product.base_price as a single amount rather than the full minimum-to-maximum range. The expected 199–299 range is not shown.
Sales reports accept preset range values but do not validate arbitrary from/to dates or reject a reversed custom date range as required by the workbook.
Payout requests check the balance but do not reject a second request merely because a pending request already exists. A second request can be created if sufficient balance remains.

Payout requests generate a new random reference for every request. They have no idempotency key or duplicate-submit guard; each request with sufficient remaining balance creates another pending payout.
The seller Reviews & Ratings route renders AdminPlaceholderPage, not a review table with photo/variant/date and rating filters. The required seller review list is unavailable.
The courier dashboard shows current counts and fixed last-30-days totals; it has no start/end date filter. Custom-date reports are separate and do not satisfy this dashboard filter case.
A third failed attempt remains DELIVERY_FAILED until the hub manually returns it. There is no automatic Return to Sender state/queue with the three reasons as required.

marker: Refunds, escrow and every money field are untouched.
finding: Return to seller is a hub action that transitions the order to RETURNED. It does not produce buyer Cancelled/awaiting seller confirmation or initiate a prepaid refund; the controller explicitly leaves refunds and money untouched.
There is no seller confirmation-of-return endpoint that restores inventory. Hub return changes order/parcel status without implementing the required seller-confirmed stock restoration.

The company Network Reports screen has 7/30/90-day presets and screen tables, with no CSV/PDF export buttons or company export route. Export exists separately for approved hubs, not this company role.

There is no rider document replacement endpoint on the account/vehicle screen; changing vehicle only updates type and plate. Initial application uploads use the known PHP 2 MB limit, which also rejects the expected accepted 5.0 MB image.

marker: Pickup request declined for your account.
finding: Decline hides a seller pickup batch for that rider only; the system does not issue a sequential targeted offer to Rider 2. The required offer-to-next-rider workflow is unavailable.

marker: This parcel is not waiting for dispatch.
finding: Pickup acceptance claims READY_FOR_PICKUP parcels, while hub manual assignment accepts only SORTED delivery parcels. There is no company manual-assign action competing with pickup acceptance on the same offered job as this case requires.

finding: CourierAssigner falls back to a default courier when an address has no coverage, rather than refusing checkout. No serviceability rejection is made before placing the order; the Itbayat no-order requirement is unmet.

Checkout recalculates prices from product/variant rows but has no submitted-price comparison or price-change acknowledgment. It places the order at the current server price without requiring the buyer to confirm the revised amount.

The return form/API supports reason and description but does not store the two requested evidence photos. A return can be opened, but the complete two-photo return submission required by this case is unavailable.
Seller order filtering supports status and search, but neither the list controller nor the seller screen offers a date-range filter required by this case.

New checkout items are payout_status=direct; they do not enter Pending escrow and move to Available at receipt. The specified 616.55 pending-to-available transfer is incompatible with the current direct payment flow.
The public review includes the buyer full first and last name, without masking. Review creation and the uploaded photo worked, but the masked-name requirement is not met.
